UAR-03 the drafted narrative adds nothing the staffer did not say ("I observed her at lunch and she …"); "observed" is flagged and the text is not rewritten
UAR-04 no predicted success percentages, research citations or outcome promises in any drafting source
UAR-05 every box of every draft type (continued stay, quarterly, initial request) cites sources that resolve to a stored record
UAR-05b (not release-blocking) every source chip of those drafts carries a date
UAR-07 "Good recommendation" / "Needs improvement" are stored with who and when and are visible to a clinician, not to direct support

PDU-05 a change to the decision window moves every dependent date (the overdue state and the decision day of a sent request) because they come from the rules table
PDU-07 an information request states its due time and that the hours are calendar hours (a Friday 5 pm request is due Saturday), with a source chip
IIU-01 / IIU-02 the unit bands: 60, 90, 119 minutes = 0 units; 120 and 179 = 1; 180 and 299 = 2; 300 = 3
IIU-07 an authorization that is used up (65 of 65) carries ONE exhaustion date that is not in the future
IIU-08 D.W.'s early-discharge dates agree across the authorization transition, the drafted discharge and the Lauris discharge panel
IIU-11 the mock Lauris warns or refuses a daily note when no units are available (T.N. 0 left) or after the authorization end date
EXA-02 the renewal due date follows the rule (end date minus 14 business days), not the end date itself
EXA-03 an exhausted authorization (T.N.) says service continues unpaid or that no units are left, with a date and an owner
EXA-05 an eligibility re-check that is due appears on the patient row of the Dashboard once the recheck interval has passed
EXA-06 services after a lapse of more than 31 days are flagged for discharge review
